title: The Lars Homestead
description: Professor Aris Thorne, a historian fascinated by the Skywalker legacy, wants to investigate the abandoned Lars Homestead. It's one of the most significant historical sites on Tatooine—the place where Luke Skywalker grew up. The local authorities won't allow official exploration, but if someone were to investigate independently, the professor would pay well for any historical artifacts or information found.
shortDescription: Investigate the Lars Homestead for historical artifacts

objectives.description: Speak with Professor Aris Thorne about the Lars Homestead
Investigate the homestead for historical artifacts
Return the datapad to Professor Thorne
